SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.2. Special Branch.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & FILE IN REGISTRY. No. D 47034 Shanghai Date 20 / 7 / 33 July 19 to 33）

Subject (in full) Enquiry from British Consulate-General re:
movements of P.A. Libanoff.

Made by D.S. Prokofiev. Forwarded by （签名）

With reference to the letter dated July 18, 1933 from
H.B.M. Consulate-General on the subject of the movements of
P.A. Libanoff, manager of the Shanghai branch of United Petroleum
Trust of U.S.S.R. (Soyouzneft), I have to report that this
individual left Shanghai for Tientsin on April 11, 1933 by the
s.s. "Shuntien" and returned by rail on or about May 1.
According to our information he has not left Shanghai since.
On June 27 he was admitted as a patient into the Country
Hospital where he was operated upon for aprendicitis. He was
discharged from the hospital on July 12 and is at present
residing in Flat 17, No.455 Rue Lafayette (Park Apartments).
In view of the above it is very doubtful that Libanoff
could visit Macassar in April this year. We also have no
information regarding his visiting the Netherlands Indies at
any other time.
P.A. Libanoff's photograph is on file and may be of
use for the purpose of proving or disproving his identity
with Litvinoff, representative of the Sino-Russo Oil Syndicate
who visited Macassar in April 1933.

（左侧批注：批）
（左侧批注：Photo No 2681 copy attached JBR 21/7）

G. Prokofiev
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch. S2. Meave blme.
（底部批注：ai.. 2B. Spare copy attached. DSR 21/7. have a spare copy of Libanoff's photograph. 21/7 1933）

（印：上海公共租界工部局 C. & 档案存登记处。编号 D 47034 上海 日期 1933年7月20日 1933年7月19日至）

主题（全称） 英国总领事馆关于 P.A. Libanoff 行踪的查询。

由警佐 Prokofiev 制作。转发人 （签名）

兹就英国驻华总领事馆 1933 年 7 月 18 日来函，关于苏联联合石油托拉斯（Soyouzneft）上海分公司经理 P.A. Libanoff 的行踪一事，谨报告如下：此人于 1933 年 4 月 11 日乘“顺天”号轮船离开上海前往天津，并于 5 月 1 日左右乘火车返回。据我方掌握的信息，此后他未再离开上海。6 月 27 日，他作为病人入住宏恩医院（Country Hospital），并接受了阑尾炎手术。他于 7 月 12 日出院，目前居住在拉斐德路 455 号（公园公寓）17 室。
鉴于上述情况，Libanoff 在今年 4 月访问望加锡（Macassar）的可能性极小。我们也无任何信息表明他在其他时间曾访问荷属东印度。
P.A. Libanoff 的照片已存档，可用于证实或证伪其与 1933 年 4 月访问望加锡的中俄石油辛迪加代表 Litvinoff 是否为同一人。

（左侧批注：批）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4734
Date 22 / 7 / 33

July 21 33.

Dear Barton,

I have to refer to your letter of July 18
regarding one Littvinoff, representative of the
Sino-Russo Oil Syndicate who visited Macassar in
April 1933, and who is suspected to be identical
with P.A. Libanoff, Manager of the Shanghai Branch
of the United Petroleum Trust of U.S.S.R. (Soyouzneft),
and to forward herewith for your information a copy of
a report made Det. Sergeant Prokofiev on the movements
of Libanoff together with a copy of his photograph.

Yours sincerely,

J. Barton, Esq.,
British Consulate-General.

（批：x See also file D 4832.）

1933年7月21日。

亲爱的 Barton：

我需提及您 7 月 18 日的来信，该信涉及中俄石油辛迪加代表 Littvinoff，此人于 1933 年 4 月访问了望加锡，并被怀疑与苏联联合石油托拉斯（Soyouzneft）上海分公司经理 P.A. Libanoff 为同一人。现随函附上警佐 Prokofiev 关于 Libanoff 行踪的报告副本及其照片副本，供贵方参考。

此致
敬礼，

J. Barton 先生，
英国总领事馆。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4734
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
18th July 1933.

My dear Givens,

With reference to your letter No.D.4734 of
April, 18th.

A report has been received that a Russian named
Littvinoff representing the Sino-Russo Oil Syndicate, visited
Macassar in April in connection with the import into the
Netherlands Indies of Soviet oil, and that contracts have been
concluded by him for the construction of oil tanks at Macassar
and elsewhere in the Celebes.

Have you heard anything further of the movements
of P.A.Libanoff as it would appear almost certain that Littvinoff
mentioned in the above report is identical with this man.

Yours sincerely,

T.P.Givens, Esq.,
Special Branch,
S.M.P.

（批：D.S. Robertson.）
（批：S2, For inquiry and report please.）
（批：JAS Roy?）

亲爱的 Givens：

兹复贵方 4 月 18 日第 D.4734 号信函。

收到一份报告称，一名代表中俄石油辛迪加的名为 Littvinoff 的俄国人，于 4 月因苏联石油进口至荷属东印度事宜访问了望加锡，并且他已就在望加锡及西里伯斯（Celebes）其他地方建造油罐签订了合同。

关于 P.A. Libanoff 的行踪，阁下是否听到更多消息？因为上述报告中提到的 Littvinoff 似乎几乎可以肯定就是此人。

此致
敬礼，

T.P. Givens 先生，
特别股，
上海公共租界工部局。

Date July 4, 1933

Subject (in full) Letter from British Consulate-General re: Dickson alleged
Comintern representative in India.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the letter dated May 23,1933 from
H.B.M. Consulate-General on the subject of Dickson believed to
have been appointed Comintern representative in India, I have
to report that enquiries have failed to elicit any information
regarding this individual's presence in Shanghai.
Enquiries in connection with this matter are proceeding
and Dickson's description has been passed to the Chinese Autho-
rities with a view to securing their co-operation in tracing him
if he visits Shanghai.

[签名]
G. Prokofiev
D. S.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4734
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O.BOX 259, SHANGHAI.
23rd May 1933.

My dear Givens,

With reference to my previous enquiries on the
subject of Comintern agents who might be leaving the Far East
for India, I have to inform you that a report has been received
recently to the effect that a man named DICKSON, nationality
not known, has been appointed Comintern representative in India.
His description is as follows: age about 45, medium height,
dark complexion and black hair, dark eyes, thin lips, long thin
face with high narrow forehead. He is believed to be generally
known as "Dick" and has a peculiar habit of twitching his left
shoulder when he is speaking.

He is reported to have been in Peking in 1928
and from there to have proceeded to South China. In 1931 he is
believed to have been in the Straits Settlements and in 1932 in
the Philippines.

If this man comes through Shanghai it will be of
the greatest importance to us to know it and I should be obliged
if this information could be passed to the Chinese authorities
with a view to securing their co-operation in tracing him if he
visits this part of the world.

Yours sincerely,
Laurence Harlow

Chinese
Authorities
informed

For attention
and report

1933年5月23日。

亲爱的 Givens：

兹就我之前关于可能从远东前往印度的共产国际特工的查询，特此告知，最近收到一份报告，称一名名为 DICKSON、国籍不明的人已被任命为共产国际驻印度代表。其体貌特征如下：年龄约 45 岁，中等身材，肤色黝黑，黑发，深色眼睛，嘴唇薄，脸型瘦长，前额高而窄。据信他通常被称为“Dick”，说话时有抽动左肩的特殊习惯。

据报道，他于 1928 年在北京，随后前往华南。据信他于 1931 年在海峡殖民地，1932 年在菲律宾。

如果此人经过上海，知悉此事对我们至关重要。如能将此信息转交中国当局，以便在他访问本地区时争取中方合作进行追踪，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，
Laurence Harlow

（左侧手写批注：）
中国
当局
已通知
1月23/6

S.Q.
请留意
并报告。
JMS

（底部手写标注：）
1933年5月27日 A. S. Proctor / J.S.R 5月24日。

April 18 33.

Dear Barton,

I have to refer to your letter of April 6
and to state that a report will be sent to you in
case information is received of Communist agents
leaving Shanghai under circumstances which might
mean that they were proceeding to India. I forward
in the meantime a copy of a report by a member of the
Special Branch regarding Soviet agents who, according
to recent reports, have the intention of leaving for
India or the Netherlands East Indies.

Yours sincerely,

J. Barton, Esq.,
British Consulate-General.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
File No.
No. D 4734
Date April 10, 1933.

Subject (in full) Letter from British Consulate-General re alleged departure of
an important agent of the Comintern from the Far East to India.

Made by D.S. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the letter dated April 7, 1933 from
H.B.M. Consulate-General on the subject of an important agent
of the Comintern, name unknown, who is alleged to have left
recently or to be about to leave the Far East for India, I
have to state that no information to this effect is, so far,
available in this office.

In this connection, however, it is of interest to note
that the following Soviet agents were reported recently to
have the intention of proceeding either to India or to
Netherlands East Indies :-

(1) V. Novikoff, employee of the Harbin branch of the Centrosojus.
During his last sojourn in Shanghai in October 1932 it was
reported that he intended to proceed to India with the object
of finding a market there for Soviet products. He left
Shanghai for an unknown destination towards the beginning
of November 1932. According to an unconfirmed report
(vide attached translation from French Police Intelligence
Report) he is at present in Persia. (File I.O.7860/25).

(2) P.A. Libanoff, manager of the local branch of the United
Petroleum Trust of U.S.S.R. According to the letter dated
January 31, 1933 from the Netherlands Consulate-General,
a certain N.M. Jacobs made enquiries at that consulate on
behalf of P.A. Libanoff regarding "regulations for business
and tourist visa". Libanoff, he stated, intended to visit
Netherlands India on a pleasure trip and at the same time
keep himself posted on business conditons there. (File
D-1955) Libanoff left for Tientsin on April 11, 1933
by the s.s. Shuntien.

(3) G. Popoff-Peipin alias G. Berry-Popoff, suspected Soviet

主题（全称） 英国总领事馆来函：关于一名重要的共产国际特工据称从远东前往印度。

由警佐 Prokofiev 制作。转发人 [签名]

兹就英国驻华总领事馆 1933 年 4 月 7 日来函，关于一名姓名不详的重要共产国际特工据称最近已离开或即将离开远东前往印度一事，谨声明：截至目前，本办公室尚无此类信息。

然而，在此方面，值得注意的是，最近据报道以下苏联特工有意前往印度或荷属东印度：

(1) V. Novikoff，中央消费合作总社（Centrosojus）哈尔滨分公司雇员。
在他 1932 年 10 月最后一次逗留上海期间，据报道他打算前往印度，目的是为苏联产品寻找市场。他于 1932 年 11 月初离开上海前往未知目的地。根据一份未经证实的报告（见附件法国警察情报报告译文），他目前在波斯。（档案 I.O.7860/25）。

(3) G. Popoff-Peipin，化名 G. Berry-Popoff，疑似苏联

March 24,1933.    V.Novikoff's departure to Persia.

We learn that V.D.Novikoff,employee of the Soviet
Textile Syndicate, and an agent of the G.P.U.,whose
departure for Dairen was reported,left that port for
Persia recently.

April 3,1933.    Popoff-Peipin intends proceeding to the Pacific Islands

Complementary to the information given in our report
of March 16,1933,p.1,para.1,we learn that G.Popoff-Pei-
pin alias Berry,Soviet agent,who is strongly suspected
of working on behalf of the G.P.U. and who left for
Canton on March 15, intends proceeding from there to
the Pacific Islands. With this object in view he obtain-
ed,on February 15,from the Public Safety Bureau a Russian
émigrants passport under the name of G.Popoff-Berry,per-
mitting him to travel abroad.

1933年3月24日。    V. Novikoff 启程前往波斯。

获悉苏联纺织辛迪加雇员、国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）特工 V.D. Novikoff，此前据报道其启程前往大连，最近已离开该港口前往波斯。

1933年4月3日。    Popoff-Peipin 打算前往太平洋岛屿

作为对我方 1933 年 3 月 16 日报告第 1 页第 1 段所给信息的补充，获悉苏联特工 G. Popoff-Peipin（化名 Berry），被强烈怀疑为国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）效力，并于 3 月 15 日前往广州，打算从那里前往太平洋岛屿。为此目的，他于 2 月 15 日从公安局获得了一本名为 G. Popoff-Berry 的俄侨护照，允许其出国旅行。

April 6th 1933.

My dear Givens,

I have recently received information that
an important agent of the Comintern is reported to be
leaving the Far East for India (he may have already left).
I am passing you this information in case you should hear
of any of the known Communist agents in Shanghai leaving
here under circumstances which might mean that they were
proceeding to India.

Yours sincerely,
Vance Parker.

T.P.Givens, Esq.,
